history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration disclose information on the performance of post resources from extrabudgetary resources in order to improve its transparency.
history.administration_response: The General Assembly, in paragraph 29 of its resolution 77/262, took note of the recommendation of the Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions in paragraph 75 of its report (A/77/7) and therefore rejected the Advisory Committee’s recommendation requesting more detailed extrabudgetary information in the budget. In the context of an early engagement process with Member States, the presentation format of budget proposals was presented to Member States for any further guidance regarding the Secretariat’s interpretation of resolution 77/262. The Secretariat’s interpretation was supported by the early engagement process. Considering the above decision by the Assembly, and the outcome of the early engagement with the Member States on the proposed programme budget for 2024, the Administration will continue to provide the existing information on extrabudgetary resources in the budget fascicle and supplementary notes. The Administrations requests the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that enhancements regarding the disclosure of the financial resources required from regular budget and extrabudgetary sources are included in the proposed programme budget for 2024, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
